text: The R2R Program features a pre-disaster recovery planning 'playbook' that includes standardized templates and operational guidance. It integrates with the GeoRiskPH multi-hazard database for science-based planning and aligns with the CAT-DDO financing facility to ensure readiness for funding recovery efforts. The program has a nationwide training reach, equipping local governments with the necessary skills and knowledge for effective disaster recovery.

metadata.solution_name: Ready to Rebuild: Disaster Rehabilitation and Recovery Program (R2R Program)
